description: Resolve Git merge conflicts in a pricing application. A merge from 'main' into 'feature-pricing' has conflicts in 2 files: src/utils.py and src/config.py. In src/utils.py, the incoming change from main adds a tax_rate parameter to calculate_price function (current only has discount). Accept the incoming change to get the complete tax calculation feature. In src/config.py, the incoming change has better production values (TIMEOUT=60, RETRIES=5 vs current TIMEOUT=30, RETRIES=3). Accept the incoming change. After resolving both files, stage all changes and complete the merge commit. Use VSCode's Source Control panel and conflict resolution UI (Accept Current/Incoming Change buttons).
